description.value: Indian Flavors is a full-service Indian restaurant in Golden, BC, situated on the Trans-Canada Highway and founded in 2023. The menu spans a wide range of North Indian cuisine—tandoori meats and seafood, curries, biryanis, and Indo-Chinese noodles—alongside an extensive vegetarian and vegan selection. For touring cyclists passing through Golden on the Trans-Canada corridor, it offers a sit-down meal with online ordering available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, operating Indian restaurant at 1205 Trans-Canada Hwy, Golden BC, founded in 2023. OSM tags diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes are corroborated by the extensive vegetarian menu on the website (paneer tikka, veg platter, tandoori veg items). The website's 'Order Online' button confirms takeout availability; no evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities was found in either the OSM tags or the website content.
concerns: OSM record has no address, phone, or website tags; all contact info sourced from the discovered website URL only — contact_confirmed fields cannot be validated against OSM.
Business name alternates between 'Indian Flavors' and 'Indian Flavours' (British spelling) on the website; OSM uses 'Indian Flavors'.
OSM note indicates former name was 'Kicking Horse Palace' — no further detail on when the rebrand occurred.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant on the Trans-Canada Highway in Golden with an active website and confirmed contact details. A clear stop for touring cyclists passing through the Kootenay corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website menu confirms dedicated vegetarian appetizer and main course sections with numerous paneer, soybean, and veg items
